intro: Craven Drok is a wandering orc found skulking in the dimly lit tunnels of the Cleft of Shadow beneath Orgrimmar. True to his moniker, he keeps to the dark corners of the city, occasionally reaching out to travelers willing to deliver sensitive correspondence concerning the Horde's enemies.

p: While most orcs of Orgrimmar proudly walk the sunlit avenues of the Valley of Honor or the Valley of Strength, Craven Drok avoids the daylight entirely. He haunts the winding, subterranean paths of the Cleft of Shadow, an enclave typically reserved for warlocks, rogues, and practitioners of less honorable trades. Drok lives up to his cowardly reputation, preferring to stay out of sight while hiring passersby to carry out his discreet errands, including dispatches touching on Alliance activities.
